1) the introduction of an economic dimension in health policy decisions does not conflict with ethical principles, and 2) the physician can play an important role in increasing the quality of health care, without restricting the provision or quality of services, and without compromising the physician-patient relationship.

the ethical and economic aspects of the physician's role in the health care system.
